subject.title: fix: keep tail alive and replay timed-out messages

question: Should Discrawl adopt this fail-closed tail contract, including fatal detached ordered timeouts, private durable fallback state, and bounded automatic or operator-triggered exact-message replay?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and heavily tested, but it intentionally changes live ordering, durable recovery state, and operator semantics in the core archival path.

options.title: Accept the recovery contract
options.body: Merge after an area owner confirms the timeout, fallback, replay, and delete semantics as the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Narrow the operator surface
options.body: Land durable failure ownership and fallback recording but defer replay-only CLI behavior or scheduled exact replay to a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Retain current semantics
options.body: Do not merge if maintainers prefer handler timeout failures to remain fatal without durable exact-message replay state.

recommendation.title: Accept the recovery contract
recommendation.body: Merge after an area owner confirms the timeout, fallback, replay, and delete semantics as the intended long-term contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most directly connects this owner to syncer shutdown and storage reliability behavior.
